audits.claim_text: Fresh Qwen3.5-9B lowering candidates are semantically equivalent to the 388 confirmed E3 IR and binding pairs under the frozen Explorer contract.
audits.scope: All 388 dataset rows with confirmed ir_gt and binding_gt; fresh Hyper-AI/Qwen3.5-9B-fp8 generation; horizon-free Explorer; unconditional outcome accounting.

run_selection.selection_rule: Include all 388 protocol case IDs exactly once; retain generation errors, refusals, divergences, and equivalences.

check_results.rationale: The protocol preceded candidate bytes and fixes all payloads, sources, model, sampling, caps, taxonomy, and retry separation.
Equivalence requires horizon-free closure; divergence requires concrete replay; failure kinds remain separate.
This audit covers one Qwen run and makes no comparative model claim.
All 388 IDs occur once: 208 EQUIV-FIXPOINT, 27 DIVERGE_CONFIRMED, 27 REFUSED, and 126 GENERATION_ERROR.
A server failure prevented candidates for 126/388 cases, so 208/388 cannot estimate a completed full-run success rate.
Generation availability is confounded with later case order, and predecessor outcomes informed remediation.
Every available candidate has a byte hash and matching frozen input; the exact served model ID is recorded.
The evaluator verified all 157 source hashes before and after the run.
This is a repository-local self-audit with no independent evaluator or unseen held-out set.

independence.evidence: No independent review or authority separation was claimed.

limitations: WITHDRAWN FROM PAPER USE: this run used faulty global service-prefix resolution; historical counts do not support model-performance claims.
126 generation failures came from one server connection interruption and are not semantic verdicts.
The 27 refusals and 27 divergences apply only to 262 successfully generated artifacts.
Predecessor outcomes informed remediation, so this evidence is exploratory.
Repository hashes provide continuity, not external immutability.

predecessor_failures.rationale: Confirmed binding injection, static validation, and general semantic rules remove the identified mismatches.
The endpoint reset; 126 cases require a lineage-recorded technical retry after recovery.

audits.minimum_corrective_action: Restore the frozen endpoint, technically retry exactly the 126 APIConnectionError cases with lineage, then prepare and evaluate the completed 388-case set.
